notes.title: Beta-1.0.1 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi, Eddy again!

Thank you to everyone who shared suggestions and reported bugs. Your voices have been heard, and we have worked on fixing a lot of bugs this week.

 Changes:

Base stat line for Rook is nerfed to 2/3.


Base stat line for Bishop is nerfed to 3/2.


CheapSkate is nerfed to 2/4.


Cookie is changed to: “Heal a friendly non-king piece to full.”


Gearup is changed to: “Pay X to give a friendly piece +X+1 Attack this turn.”


Gobleader is changed to: “Every 3 turns, steal a card from the opponent's hand.”


Vengeful Spirit buffed to 3/1.


Reduced the number of shop encounters.


Removed Overture from Raise Flag.


Removed Overture from Best Offer.


Reduced the hand size to 7.


Made tutorials more understandable.


Added a rook to the Syndicate starting deck.


Added a move to the Syndicate starting deck.


Gave sacrificed pieces a different outline color.


Bug Fixes:

Fixed the bug where alt-tabbing sometimes froze the game.


Fixed the bug where pressing "Esc" twice froze the game.


Fixed the bug report system.


Fixed the bug where the same piece could be sacrificed twice.


Fixed visual bugs where keywords were not displayed correctly.


Fixed the bug where the graveyard’s remaining card text lingered after shuffling.


Fixed the bug where deck inspection showed up when using the rightmost card.


Fixed some known memory leaks.


Fixed the bug where Thorn did not trigger correctly.


Fixed some wording in English and Simplified Chinese.



Fixed the bug where cancel usage of TradeOff will still trigger the effect.
